\chapter{Figure and data provenance}\label{app:provenance}

This appendix lists, in the order of the book, the script in the repository \url{https:/\allowbreak{}/\allowbreak{}github.com/\allowbreak{}hmahaffeyges/\allowbreak{}IAM-Validation}
that draws each figure and the data that script reads, and the record or script behind each table of numbers, so that a
reader can rerun each figure and trace each number. Paths are relative to the repository root. The chain
helper \texttt{docs/\allowbreak{}book/\allowbreak{}figscripts/\allowbreak{}\_\allowbreak{}chains.py} reads the Cobaya chains with
a 30\,\% burn-in and weighted statistics; the growth helper \texttt{\_\allowbreak{}cosmo.py} in the same folder solves the linear
growth equation with the same early amplitude for $\Lambda$CDM and for IAM. A figure whose script reads no file is
computed from constants and from the values written in the script, which are those of the chapter that shows it.
Where one script draws several figures, the last column lists every file that script reads.
This list is generated by \texttt{docs/\allowbreak{}book/\allowbreak{}figscripts/\allowbreak{}make\_\allowbreak{}app\_\allowbreak{}I.py}.
